interface.name: Building Width
interface.description: Length of the right-hand facade (m)

interface.name: Building Depth
interface.description: Length of the left-hand facade (m)

interface.name: Floor Count
interface.description: Total floors including the shop floor

interface.name: Floor Height
interface.description: Upper floor height (ignored when Building Height > 0)

interface.name: Building Height
interface.description: Wall height to cornice. 0 = derive from Floor Count x Floor Height

interface.name: Ground Floor Height
interface.description: Shop floor height

interface.name: Corner Angle
interface.description: Angle between the two street facades

interface.name: Facade Offset
interface.description: Solid wall margin at each facade end (corner piers)

interface.name: Bay Width
interface.description: Target window bay spacing

interface.name: Facade Seed
interface.description: Variation seed: same seed = same building

interface.name: Detail Level
interface.description: LOW: facade/windows/shops. MEDIUM: +interiors, AC, balconies, fire escapes, blinds, signs. HIGH: +shop/window furniture, curtains, cables, pipes, escalator, props

interface.name: Building Imperfection
interface.description: 0 = perfectly organized, 1 = organically chaotic

interface.name: Brick Scale
interface.description: Brick size multiplier (1 = 22.5 cm bricks)

interface.name: Brick Offset
interface.description: Running bond offset

interface.name: Facade Variation
interface.description: Colour variation / patching

interface.name: Stone Detail
interface.description: Stone corner quoins

interface.name: Band Every
interface.description: Extra horizontal band every N floors (0 = only above shops and below top floor)

interface.name: Attic Panels
interface.description: Decorative stone panels between top-floor windows

interface.name: Detail Seed
interface.description: Reroll Facade independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Window Open Amount
interface.description: 0 closed, 0.5 half, 1 fully open (sash physically moves)

interface.name: Window Open Randomness
interface.description: How chaotic the opening amounts are

interface.name: Blind Probability
interface.description: Roller / venetian / vertical

interface.name: Blind Open Amount
interface.description: 0 closed, 1 open

interface.name: Curtain Probability
interface.description: Left / right / both

interface.name: Window Seed
interface.description: Reroll Windows independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: AC Probability
interface.description: Window + AC weight

interface.name: Balcony Probability
interface.description: Window + balcony weight

interface.name: Shutter Probability
interface.description: Window + shutter weight

interface.name: Blank Probability
interface.description: Blank wall weight (window = remainder)

interface.name: Module Seed
interface.description: Reroll Facade Modules independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: AC Variation
interface.description: Mix of unit types, sizes, pipe/cable randomness

interface.name: AC Seed
interface.description: Reroll AC Units independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Balcony Seed
interface.description: Reshuffle which windows get balconies. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Interior Depth
interface.description: Depth of the projected room boxes

interface.name: Interior Seed
interface.description: Reroll Interiors independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Ceiling Gap
interface.description: Space left between a room's ceiling and the floor of the room above

interface.name: Window Light Probability
interface.description: Share of lit apartments (each lit window is DIM or ON)

interface.name: Window Light Strength
interface.description: Emission strength (raise for night renders)

interface.name: Light Color Variation
interface.description: Warm to cool

interface.name: Lighting Seed
interface.description: Reroll Lighting independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Shop Count
interface.description: Storefronts split across both facades

interface.name: Shop Seed
interface.description: Shop type / sign / awning variation

interface.name: Shop Interior Detail
interface.description: 0 projected image only, 1 +counter, lights, posters, 2 +shelves/products

interface.name: Residential Door Probability
interface.description: Chance each shop gives up an end bay to a building entrance (the first shop always gets one unless 0)

interface.name: Escalator Position
interface.description: Position inside the chosen shop

interface.name: Escape Offset
interface.description: Distance from the far facade end

interface.name: Banner Probability
interface.description: Hanging banners on platforms

interface.name: Fire Escape Seed
interface.description: Reroll Fire Escapes independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Custom Sign
interface.description: Corner blade sign with custom text

interface.name: Sign Seed
interface.description: Reroll Signs independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Roof Access
interface.description: Brick stair bulkhead with steel door

interface.name: Clotheslines
interface.description: Lines between poles with random laundry

interface.name: Vents
interface.description: Vent pipes, chimneys and mushroom vents

interface.name: Dish Probability
interface.description: Satellite dish

interface.name: Hatch Probability
interface.description: Roof hatch / skylight

interface.name: Roof Seed
interface.description: Reroll roof props independently. 0 = follow Facade Seed

interface.name: Cornice Detail
interface.description: 0 profile, 1 +brackets, 2 +dentils

interface.name: Cornice Repeat
interface.description: Bracket spacing

interface.name: Window Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Windows. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: Module Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Facade Modules. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: AC Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for AC Units. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: Lighting Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Lighting. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: Interior Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Interiors. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: Detail Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Facade. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: Fire Escape Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Fire Escapes. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed

interface.name: Sign Seed
interface.description: Offset seed for Signs. 0 keeps the result driven only by the main Seed
